_meta.notes: Phase 3A survival model improvement (NB07). True baseline 0.514 (Cox PH, all-injury). Pre-tracking NB07 improvements (arm-only event, stratified Cox, elastic-net, GBSA addition) achieved 0.5559 best C-index as of 2026-06-19. Round S-001: stochastic GBSA subsample=0.8 → C-index 0.5591 (+0.0032). Round S-002: GBSA double-stochastic null result — column subsampling and n=200 both hurt; max_features=None confirmed optimal. Round S-003: Ensemble rank-average (GBSA+Cox+RSF) → C-index 0.5658 (+0.0067). Round S-004: Log-normal AFT as 4th ensemble member → regression (0.5637, -0.0021); reverted. Round S-005: ExtraSurvivalTrees → null/regression (EST C=0.5381, all EST ensemble variants weaker than S003 base); reverted. consecutive_non_improvements=2. Next: GBSA IPCWLS loss or weighted ensemble optimization.

round_S001.description: Stochastic GBSA via subsample=0.8 — Friedman (2002) stochastic gradient boosting
round_S001.verdict: kept — C-index +0.0032, GBSA now best model; delta < 0.005 threshold so consecutive_non_improvements incremented

round_S002.verdict: null result — column subsampling consistently hurts C-index on this dataset; max_features=None confirmed optimal; default reverted; consecutive_non_improvements=2

round_S003.description: Rank-average ensemble of GBSA + Cox PH + RSF risk scores — Hothorn et al. (2004) committee method

round_S003.verdict: kept — ensemble C-index 0.5658 (+0.0067), exceeds +0.005 threshold; consecutive_non_improvements reset to 0. GBSA hyperparameter space confirmed exhausted: all 3 new configs worse than reference; depth=2, n=100, lr=0.1, sub=0.8 is optimal.

round_S004.description: Log-Normal + Log-Logistic AFT as 4th ensemble member — non-monotone hazard diversity
round_S004.verdict: reverted — 4-model ensemble WORSE than 3-model (0.5637 < 0.5658). Adding aft_lognormal (C=0.5447) diluted the ensemble signal. aft_loglogistic failed evaluation (numerical instability). consecutive_non_improvements=1.

round_S005.description: ExtraSurvivalTrees as ensemble member (replacing RSF or as 4th) — random split thresholds for decorrelation from GBSA
round_S005.verdict: reverted — EST individual C=0.5381 well below RSF (0.5537); both EST ensemble variants hurt. Root cause: random split thresholds lose signal with 91% censoring + 82 correlated features. S003 ensemble (0.5658) unchanged. consecutive_non_improvements=2.
round_S005.side_effect_kept: Cell 12 FAST_TUNING grids reduced from ~19 to 3 configs (1 per model, known best). TEST_MODE now ~20 min vs 2+ hours.
